address: The Jeddah Yacht Club, 2387 Al Kurnaysh Bridge Road, Jeddah, 23613, Saudi Arabia
bio: You can dine inside, on a terrace overlooking superyachts or even on a bobbing moored boat while enjoying Lebanese classics. This modern and bright place, located in the Jeddah Yacht Club, serves up a fine selection of dips – the beetroot moutabbal is a must – tasty grills and fresh salads that come in generous portions, so be aware of that when ordering. Finish off with the baklava – it’s not to be missed.
